method: Visually inspected all 14 contact sheets covering every page in the assigned range, and all five supplied full-size representative page images using view_image. No PDF or source modifications were made.

findings.detail: No visible clipping, overlapping lines, missing glyph boxes, or text outside page boundaries. Full-size sample pages have readable body text and mathematical strings.
Month overview tables stay within their columns and page boundaries. Header bands, row rules and wrapped text remain distinct; full-size page 4 confirms table readability.

No accidental blank pages or major layout breaks were observed. Month boundaries and short closing pages leave deliberate whitespace; continuation pages and entry headings retain coherent reading order.
Pages 1, 4, 84, 165 and 168 have clean margins, readable headings and highlighted result boxes, and unobstructed footers.

scope_limit: All 168 pages were inspected at contact-sheet scale; five specified pages were also inspected at full size. This is visual layout QA, not a new mathematical or provenance audit.
